title: Digital channels
blurb: Skills replaced new inbound queues. One script type. Agents need four things.

lessons.title: Digital Experience versus legacy channels
lessons.summary: Digital is the Digital Experience family. Legacy phone, email, and chat keep their own script types. Do not mix the POC forms.

p: Digital means any channel, contact, or skill associated with Digital Experience. The digital channels page contrasts digital skills with all non-digital ACD skills, and digital POCs with channel-specific legacy POCs.
All digital channels use POC type digital. You choose the channel when you add the point of contact.
One digital script type, with differences the scripter still handles. After you create the channel you can pick the digital script from a drop-down.
A phone script does not belong there.

choices: Any non-voice word in casual speech
Digital, then you pick the channel

A different list from digital skills
On the channel, from a drop-down, after it exists

lessons.title: The Summer 2023 routing change
lessons.summary: Before Summer 2023, digital inbound work used routing queues. New inbound configuration uses skills and scripts. Queues remain for outbound, and old inbound queues still sync.

p: Digital Routing says that prior to the Summer 2023 release, digital contacts were primarily routed with routing queues. You can still manage existing inbound queues, but all new routing configuration should use digital skills and scripts.
The system syncs queues with the ACD skills list and the reverse, so the two lists stay consistent.
Outbound interactions still use routing queues. WFA can assign a digital skill so that when the contact replies, the reply reaches an agent on that skill.
Sub-skill checkboxes for queues are not the recommended inbound method.

steps.label: Leave old queues
steps.detail: They sync. Do not clone them for a new channel.

lessons.title: Workflow automation beside Studio
lessons.summary: WFA rules run independent of Studio and can assign skills. Studio remains the recommended way to manage the contact. Use both on purpose.
objectives: Not let WFA be a surprise
Keep Studio as the recommended skill assignment

p: Digital Routing says WFA rules run independent of Studio scripts. You can use both to customize handling.
That means a rule can change the skill even when you are staring at the script. Document the rules next to the script.
Manage Digital Skills says using Studio is the recommended method to assign skills. Queue sub-skills are not recommended.
If both set a skill, know which one wins for your case by reading the current WFA page. This lesson does not invent precedence.

steps.label: Write both
steps.detail: So the next person is not surprised.

steps.label: Agent has both skills
steps.detail: Or the rule strands the contact.

choices: Change the skill the script author did not expect

lessons.title: Skill, script, and the digital POC
lessons.summary: A new digital channel needs a digital skill and a digital script as defaults. The script may change the skill later.

p: Digital Channels says that to set up a new POC you need a digital ACD skill and a Studio script as the default. They are only the starting point. The script can change which skill requests an agent.
That matches the voice pattern, with digital types.
Agents need the Digital Engagement attribute, channel permissions, a supported app, and the skill the contact ends on, not only the default.
MAX supports the digital channels the page discusses. Check Workspace apps individually.

cards.back: Skill and script, then the channel.

lessons.title: Outbound digital still uses queues
lessons.summary: Do not delete every queue. Outbound digital routing still uses them. WFA assigns the skill used when the contact replies.
objectives: Use WFA for the reply skill

p: Digital Routing says the system still uses routing queues to route outbound interactions. You configure queue filters, then WFA rules that assign the digital skill so a reply routes to an agent.
Agents must have that digital skill to receive the reply.
The ban on new queues is about new inbound configuration. Outbound is called out separately.
An inbound chat still should not start life as a new queue.

lessons.title: Widen a digital pool without acceleration
lessons.summary: Update Contact Digital widens proficiency from 1 to 20, 1 best, and its priority does not accelerate. Use WFA if digital priority must move.

p: Update Contact Digital updates priority and proficiency ranges to broaden the pool. Priority is entered from 0 to 1000 and does not have acceleration. High and low proficiency are whole numbers 1–20, 1 best.
Default routing criteria is Not Applicable, meaning you are not required to replace earlier criteria.
Do not paste (Time × Acceleration) + Initial Priority into this action. That formula is the static-delivery voice page.
If the contact must jump the digital queue, the action page points at workflow automation.
